description: This file defines an abstract class IteratorWrapper that implements the Iterator interface, providing a template for wrapping iterators with additional behavior such as conversion and validation.

classes.name: IteratorWrapper
classes.description: An abstract generic class that wraps an existing iterator to transform and validate elements during iteration.

methods.name: hasNext
methods.description: Checks if there are more elements in the iterator, applying validation and conversion logic.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Returns the next element in the iteration after applying conversion, throws exception if none available.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the last element returned by this iterator from the underlying collection.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: A protected method to determine if the current source and destination elements are valid; default implementation always returns true.

methods.name: noteRemoval
methods.description: An abstract method for subclasses to implement logic to handle removal of elements.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: An abstract method for subclasses to implement conversion from source to destination type.
